column1: # Source-owned test evidence for the dependency-closed DistSQL context leaf.

column8: The Rust leaf preserves the source detach invariants for shared warnings, SQL killer and cancellation handles, copied CPU/KV state, fresh max-keys counters, request metadata, replica-read, priority, paging, timeouts, task ID, and session identity. Full Go deep-clone coverage remains partial until TiKV client variables, runtime statistics, memory trackers, error context, resource-group hooks, and result streaming have typed Rust consumers; no RPC or protobuf behavior is claimed.
